title: Broaden the executive summary's coverage of the subject
requirements:

- Map the guidance to related WHO frameworks (GDHM, SMART Guidelines, DIIG) early in the document
- Add a brief front section setting out the decisions a country must take
- Add that DPI-H provides the means to integrate information across existing disconnected HIS components
- Mention the goal-to-component traceability as a reason to use the architecture
